title: bubipack
description: A "small" modpack built around Create and a selection of QoL, performance, and tech mods.
body:
A "small" modpack built around Create and a carefully selected set of extras.

This pack focuses on the Create mod and expands the experience across several categories:

🔧 Create & Addons
Core automation, factory building, and mechanical contraptions powered by Create and its addons.

✨ Quality of Life
Mods that make everyday gameplay smoother — better inventory management, visual improvements, and UI enhancements.

⚡ FPS & Performance
Rendering optimizations and memory improvements to keep things running well even with a heavier modpack.

🧩 Misc Additions
A few extra mods that fit the overall vibe without bloating the pack.

---

For those who want to play on a server, it's recommended to install the [Bubipack Server](https://modrinth.com/modpack/bubipackserver) modpack on the server side — this modpack is designed for the client only and isn't meant to be run directly on a server.

That said, both singleplayer and LAN play work perfectly out of the box and have been fully tested.
